items.title: Celebrities
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Fame! Who wants to live forever? Make sure to put on some dark sunglasses so no one recognizes you in Celebrities skins. Look cool in the latest styles when you role-play with friends as well-known public figures. Actor, singer, dancer, or musician, you are the star. Make sure everyone in the city remembers your name.

+ 8 welcome on the red carpet HD skins

items.title: Vampires vs Werewolves
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Relive the most epic monster battle ever in Vampires vs Werewolves skins. The scariest creatures come out at night when you role-play with friends in dreadful darkness. Become undead and search the city for wolf-like victims to bite with your pointy fangs. Go from human to hairy wolf under the full moon and take on the vampires with a horrible howl.

+ 8 haunting HD skins

items.title: Reality Stars
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Transform into your favorite celebrity and have really good fun in Reality Stars skins. Role-play with friends as singing idols or dancing darlings and become a ratings success. Get into the drama as you cry, laugh, and rage. Be the most popular VIP in the city and enjoy the fame and stardom that can only happen in the real world!

+ 8 super celeb HD skins

items.title: Horror Monsters
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Terror is turning up at every creepy corner of the city. The scares and frights are just beginning when you role-play with friends in Horror Monsters skins. Rotting faces and dark freaks roam the street, looking to bring fear and panic to everyone they meet. Watch out for the poison soul, it might just drag you down into a dark hole.

+ 8 bizarre beastly HD skins

items.title: Stone Age
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Go waaaay back in time and live a prehistoric life with Stone Age skins. Gear up with sticks and stones and role-play with friends as ancient cave dwellers. Join together as hunters, gatherers, and farmers to feed the people and protect the clan. Become a Minecraft chief leader or be an ancient healer and keep the overworld free of sickness!

+ 8 primitive HD skins

items.title: Berserker
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Work yourself into a frenzy! Become a furious, fighting warrior when you role-play with friends in Berserker skins. Gear up in armored uniform and rage at your enemies. In long beard or long hair, be ready to draw your sword and defend your tribe and leaders. Use your anger to defeat all threats that come your way.

+ 8 mad mercenary HD skins

items.title: Comets
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Streak across the sky and light up the night in cool Comets skins. Role-play with friends as truly celestial bodies, traveling on your own orbit in space. Warm up as you circle the sun, and release some ice and dust to create a famous comet tail that everyone in Minecraft can see. Make a magnificently bright meteor shower that no one will forget!

+ 8 super icy HD skins

items.title: Power Robots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s time for robot power! Choose from 8 strong machine skins and role-play as an awesome android. Use in mini-games or PvP when you need cool gear like blasters, cameras, and comms. Long live the robots!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Business Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
It's time to get to work! These mobs are pros, and working hard to make money! It's lucky they're wearing their classy new business suits, nothing can block them from reaching the sky and beyond!

- 8 mob skins
- Pick from Creeper, Enderman, Skeleton, Zombie, and many more!

items.title: Business Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These teens earn more than others. They made it! Show everybody who you are with our awesome premium skins!

- 8 awesome skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Advanced Super Heroes
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Fighting crime and helping people is a tiresome job, but thanks to these 12 new skins you will do so effortlessly and with style! 
Become the superhero you always wanted to be with advanced super heroes from Rareloot!

- 12 skins
- RareLoot

items.title: Masked Food Fight
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
This masked role play is in full swing with Masked Food Fight. Challenge your friends to a match, and find out which of your favorite food combos will win. Will it be Bacon vs. Egg, Popcorn vs. Butter, Burger vs. Fries or one of the other tasty combinations? Get this skin pack now to see!

- 1 free skin included
- 14 skins in total

items.title: Sandstone Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Lying in between pristine landscaping and marvelous gardens awaits a castle unrivaled in its magnificence and splendor.
Fit for any king desiring to live a life of indulgence.

- Survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: TNT Skins
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
There's nothing like TNT! TNT blocks have such cool designs and they are fun to use! If you love using TNT then you will love these TNT themed skins! Show your friends and your foes that you are a pro in the art of lighting TNT! What are some of the ways you use TNT? Remember to be careful using TNT!

- 9 TNT skins

items.title: SkyBlock Time
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
It's time to dress up in sky themed clothing and fly through the air! 

- 8 skyblock skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: SkyBlock Pals
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These skins are a perfect addition to your sky-themed skin collection!

- 11 skyblock skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Space Pets
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These pets have an interesting story. These pets were sent to space from Earth to explore the beyond and other worlds! Space pets have made a life for themselves among the stars and a space colony of all kinds of animals! The pets look so cute in their little space suits!

- 12 space pet skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Royal City Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Roam freely around the island and experience the life of royalty and adventure. From selling items at the market with friends, exploring pirate ships, setting up a survival camp, and more, there’s so much to do on this private rich island! 

- 8 skins
- Perfect for survival and roleplay
- Comes with a massive castle and more

items.title: Cyberpunk Mobs
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Who said mobs cannot be augmented? Hold your implants punks and be ready for cyberpunk mobs. With this skin pack, you can now play as a stylish augmented cyberpunk mob.

+ Cyberpunk
+ Sci-fi
+ Advanced future
+ Mobs

items.title: Furniture+
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to our furniture store! Choose from over 100 furniture options to decorate your house with!

+ Over 100 furniture options
+ 8 skins included
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: SCP Breached HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Multiple SCP's have escaped. All cells are unstable at this time. It is unknown what a full force of these monsters can do. SCP-1048, Scarlett King, SCP-3008, SCP-035, SCP-134, SCP-096, SCP-001, and more. Two guards and Dr. Iceberg are available to help. These monsters must be contained! 15 HD Skins.

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Food Party
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
We invite you to this fun party, it is very peculiar, because it is a food party! And it has just arrived on the marketplace, what are you waiting to wear these skins? You can be a hamburger or some popcorn, they are perfect for roleplay !

- 10 food party skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- Perfect for roleplay
- By Pixelusion & CubePlanet

items.title: Anime Illagers
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
It's your world anime illager will you be the super hero and defeat enemies? Maybe the villain who claims woodland mansions, takes command of patrols, raids, and pillager outposts.

- 11 Anime Skins

items.title: Candy Cuties
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Candy is an addictive, delicious and amazing delicacy! YUM Milkshake. 

- Colorful and vivid candy skins
